next.reason: Items a-f carry over into §2023:12.4.5.3 GR1 a-f, with the implementor consistency rules documented per §2023:A.1 72 and §2023:A.1 149. But 1985 item g 'The same specification for the PADDING CHARACTER clause' is gone (2023 has no PADDING CHARACTER clause), and 2023 adds, for a report file's sequential FCE, 'i) The same specification of the FILE STATUS clause' (plus collating sequence, sharing and lock items). External report-file connectors that differ in FILE STATUS, legal in 1985, are now nonconforming.
